purpose: Test the revised Life cluster, overlapping-lane, earned-thread, local-spatial, and editorial-admission model without selecting visual geometry or server-authored components.
prohibited_uses: Do not replace or mutate the frozen v0.1 visual-round fixture.
Do not infer occurrence from a ticket, reservation, save, photograph, or Plan alone.
Do not promote a recurring subject into a trait, identity, affinity, or stable thread without its explicit gate.
Do not publish the Rome-Paris social mosaic while its evidence grant remains a placeholder.
Do not generalize the cacio e pepe mechanism to all pasta or to an Italy-versus-United-States claim.
Do not render a global life map; spatial projection is contextual and bounded.
Do not interpret lane definitions as permanent tabs or database entities.
Do not require a reply, reflection, correction, or action to complete the value of an editorial contribution.

external_source_contracts.uncertainty: Does not explain every pasta dish, restaurant practice, or country-level sensory difference.

contribution_briefs.title: Europe reconstruction
contribution_briefs.new_value: Reconcile intended, supported actual, changed, cancelled, corrected, and unknown movement states.
contribution_briefs.bounded_headline: Your return became a second journey.
contribution_briefs.headline_gate: Use only if cancellation and rerouting records establish a materially different return sequence.
contribution_briefs.uncertainty: Unproved segments remain unknown; controlled fixture movements require owner confirmation.
contribution_briefs.why_now: Post-return evidence is available for repair, but the Journey does not inherit Home.
contribution_briefs.optional_consequence: Inspect uncertain occurrence states or export the verified sequence.
contribution_briefs.silence_condition: Only counts, chronology, or itinerary recap are available.

contribution_briefs.title: Rome, Aeneas, and Augustan political lineage
contribution_briefs.new_value: Aeneas could serve as an ancestor of Rome and, through Iulus, an ancestor of the Julian line used in Augustan literary and public culture.
contribution_briefs.bounded_headline: Aeneas gave Augustus a family tree inside Rome's origin story.
contribution_briefs.uncertainty: The tradition predates Augustus; the Ara Pacis identification is disputed; do not call Virgil simple propaganda.
contribution_briefs.why_now: It answers supplied attention with a mechanism the person did not state.
contribution_briefs.optional_consequence: Inspect an annotated Iulus lineage chain.
contribution_briefs.silence_condition: The output can only repeat that Aeneas escaped Troy and helped found Rome.

contribution_briefs.title: Rome and Paris social mosaic
contribution_briefs.new_value: Compare one practical axis neither person could observe alone while preserving two authors.
contribution_briefs.uncertainty: Coincident time and weather do not establish comparable experience.
contribution_briefs.why_now: Only while an addressed grant is valid and the comparison adds perception.
contribution_briefs.silence_condition: Current fixture condition: social evidence is a placeholder, not a valid content grant.

contribution_briefs.title: Red Hook consequential translation
contribution_briefs.new_value: Distinguish saved, used, and currently available access conditions, then prepare a live comparison.
contribution_briefs.bounded_headline: Red Hook has not been one trip from your life.
contribution_briefs.headline_gate: Use only when two supported episodes show materially different access patterns; otherwise label literally.
contribution_briefs.uncertainty: Infrastructure and route choice are volatile and origin-dependent; recurrence is not affinity.
contribution_briefs.why_now: An open weekend can make a learned Place relation consequential.
contribution_briefs.optional_consequence: Places refreshes live reachability from the actual origin.
contribution_briefs.silence_condition: Fewer than two supported episodes, no access difference, no live refresh, or only a visit count.

contribution_briefs.title: Pasta creaminess as a bounded mechanism
contribution_briefs.new_value: For cacio e pepe, starch concentration and temperature affect protein aggregation and sauce stability.
contribution_briefs.bounded_headline: For cacio e pepe, 'creamy' is partly a stability problem.
contribution_briefs.uncertainty: Does not establish why all Italian pasta tasted different or what a specific restaurant did.
contribution_briefs.why_now: It turns supplied curiosity into a bounded, transferable cooking mechanism.
contribution_briefs.optional_consequence: Run a one-variable at-home comparison when requested or timely.
contribution_briefs.silence_condition: The output generalizes to all Italian pasta, supplies a generic recipe, or repeats the owner's hypothesis.
